Code of Conduct for participants:

The model is a real, living human with feelings. We are privileged to draw them in a vulnerable position, and they trust us to be naked in a room with us so we can practice drawing. RESPECT the model, RESPECT their space, and be MINDFUL of their comfort during the entire workshop.

-DO NOT touch the model. Stay behind the blue tape while we are in session. DO NOT approach their chair, DO NOT touch their personal things.

-DO NOT take photographs of the model. We will store phones upstairs during the live drawing. Participants are  able to collect phones upstairs during breaktime.

-DO NOT talk to the model during the workshop. Unless spoken to first, do not talk to the model, or about the model. A model may approach you about your work, but this conversation must not be initiated by the artist. If you have a question about lighting, or model posing, please talk to the organizer of the session.

-DO NOT body shame, objectify, or misgender the model.

-DO NOT ask the model out on a date, or ask personal questions during the entire session. This is a professional working environment, and everyone will be treated with mutual respect.

**** IF any of these rules are violated, organizers and DAYBREAK will request participants to leave the venue. Depending on the severity of the violation, DAYBREAK and organizers will ban a participant from joining future events held at DAYBREAK.
